context: Manager debriefs a subordinate after a system outage
purpose: Teach: ボード/部下/発注/切り替え/エラー/同期/私立/志向

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: リク、昨日の発注システムの件、ホワイトボードの前で一度整理しよう。
lines.en: Riku, about yesterday's ordering system issue, let's organize it in front of the whiteboard.
lines.style: Calm manager opening, professional yet supportive workplace tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: はい、申し訳ありませんでした。発注処理の途中でエラー表示が出て、画面が固まってしまったんです。
lines.en: Yes, I'm sorry. An error appeared during the ordering process and the screen froze.
lines.style: Apologetic young subordinate, nervous but trying to explain clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 君は部下の中でも責任感が強いから自分を責めがちだけど、原因はサーバーの同期が止まったことだ。
lines.en: You tend to blame yourself because you're a responsible subordinate, but the cause was the server sync stopping.
lines.style: Reassuring boss reframing blame, steady measured cadence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: バックアップへの切り替えがもう少し早ければ、被害は減らせたと思います。
lines.en: If the switch to the backup had been a bit faster, I think we could have reduced the damage.
lines.style: Self-reflective junior offering honest technical assessment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 君は私立大出身で理論には強いけど、現場では結果志向だけでなく手順の冷静さも大事だぞ。
lines.en: You're a private-university grad and strong on theory, but on-site, not just a results-oriented mindset but calm procedure matters too.
lines.style: Mentor framing growth point, balancing acknowledgment with constructive coaching.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。次回は手順書をボードに貼り出して、落ち着いて対応します。
lines.en: You're absolutely right. Next time I'll post the procedure on the board and respond calmly.
lines.style: Receptive subordinate committing to a concrete behavioral change.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: うん、それでいい。同期の佐藤にも今回の発注エラーの教訓を共有しておいてくれ。
lines.en: Good, that's the way. Please also share the lessons from this ordering error with your peer Sato.
lines.style: Manager assigning follow-up, collaborative team-building directive.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: はい、必ず伝えます。気持ちの切り替えをして、明日からまた頑張ります。
lines.en: Yes, I'll be sure to tell him. I'll switch my mindset and work hard again from tomorrow.
lines.style: Closing affirmation, resolute and forward-looking junior employee.
